name: Fish Tikka Naan Wrap with Yogurt, Cilantro & Veggie-Mango Salad

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (2 ½ cm) pieces ginger root
3 lemons
1 ½ mangoes
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place both in a large bowl.
Juice half of the lemons into the bowl with the ginger and garlic (set remaining lemons aside for later use). Add yogurt, spices, and sugar; whisk to combine the marinade.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ cup plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp chili powder
1 ½ tsp cumin, ground
1 ½ tsp coriander, ground
1 ½ tsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp turmeric, ground
3 pinch cayenne pepper
¾ tsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: Cut fish into 1-inch pieces; add to the bowl with the marinade, gently stir to coat, and set aside.
Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack about 6 inches from the top. Line a large baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Juice remaining lemons into a medium bowl; add oil, salt, and pepper. Whisk to combine the dressing.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Using a clean cutting board, peel mangoes and slice flesh away from the pits, starting with the flat sides; small dice and add to the bowl with the dressing.
Trim and small dice cucumbers; halve tomatoes lengthwise. Add both to the bowl and set aside.

Transfer fish to the baking sheet and arrange in a single layer. Place baking sheet in the oven and broil, turning the fish pieces halfway through, until golden and flesh flakes with a fork, about 8 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing and veggies, then stir to combine the salad.
Just before serving, divide naan between two additional baking sheets. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping once, until toasted 1-2 minutes; remove from oven.
Spread yogurt over each naan and top with a small portion of salad and the fish. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)

To make wraps easier to eat, place each naan on a square of parchment paper. Use the paper to tightly roll and secure each wrap. Otherwise, eat as is and get a little messy! Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
